title: Stellar - Modular - Long Panel
seoTitle: Stellar Modular Steel Roof Panels - Premium Quality Tiles
description: Explore Stellar's modular steel roof panels. Made from G90 steel with a matte crinkle finish, offering elegance and durability. Perfect for any project.

sections.text: Rudan Tile, modular steel roof panels is an innovative and unique new metal roofing product. The tiles are made of premium G90 steel, with matt crinkle look color coating with strong resistance to abrasion and corrosion. Attractive & elegant appearance combined with top quality make it top choice with architects, contractors and homeowners alike.

The Rudan profile is available in a tile , modular panel or Ful Length Metal Sheets. An innovative and unique new metal roofing product. The tiles are made of premium G90 steel, with matt crinkle look color coating with strong resistance to abrasion and corrosion.

The contours on the Stellar tile stands out with its artful embossed 5 lower waves and 6 crests, truly unique design.

Shaped and resembling like the European Clay tiles, yet still combining traditional with modern appearance.

Metal tiles are one of the smartest long term solutions in residential and commercial market. Its increasing popularity with architect and homeowners, both in new build and re-roofing is owed to the fact that it distinguishes itself by being 100% recyclable and environmentally friendly& sustainable roofing product!

sections.html:
• Artfully shaped, forming beautiful contours, is what makes this product so attractive to homeowners and roofers alike.
  • Protective 275g (Zn) zinc coating, which protects the steel roofing tile from corrosion and gives it unmatched durability and longevity.
  • Excellent water/snow shedding properties, prevents and eliminates water or moisture from lingering on the roof surface
  • No special care or maintenance required ensuring peace of mind for you and your family for years to come..
  • Ample vertical ribbing reinforces the Stellar Tile metal roof panels, increases its rigidity and strengthens the whole roof in general.
  • One of the longest warranty on the market for modular type of product, 50 years+

sections.html:
• Designed with ease and speed of installation in mind our Stellar Tile is highly recommended by roofers, contractors, installers and perfect for DIY market.
  • One standard palette can be loaded with 3,032.73 sq feet (281.75 m2) 350 panels of roofing – substantial savings on transport and storage.
  • Stellar Tile 350 module with covering width of 1150 mm, needs fewer straps/ battens and screws, translating into money savings and shorter installation time.
  • Stellar roof tile panels are lightweight for ease of transportation and placement onto the roof, ideal for 2 persons roofing crews!
  • Proven track record for easy and quick installation and assembly. Stellar Tile design results in 20% less waste compared to other steel roof applications.
sections.text: Designed with ease and speed of installation in mind our Stellar Tile is highly recommended by roofers, contractors, installers and perfect for DIY market. One standard palette can be loaded with 3,032.73 sq feet (281.75 m2) 350 panels of roofing – substantial savings on transport and storage. Stellar Tile 350 module with covering width of 1150 mm, needs fewer straps/ battens and screws, translating into money savings and shorter installation time. Stellar roof tile panels are lightweight for ease of transportation and placement onto the roof, ideal for 2 persons roofing crews! Proven track record for easy and quick installation and assembly. Stellar Tile design results in 20% less waste compared to other steel roof applications.

The AG Panel also known as the Rib Panel is a lightweight, exposed fastener roofing system that is most popular for agricultural buildings, storage facilities, and canopies. With ease of installation in mind, the AG Panel system is a straightforward installation with clean look and simplicity in mind.
Attractive & elegant appearance combined with top quality make it top choice with architects, contractors and homeowners alike.
